sentences.en: With the help of doctors, she got over her illness.
sentences.zh: 在医生的帮助下，她克服了疾病。

sentences.en: The old lady has been rather feeble since her illness.
sentences.zh: 这位老太太自从生病后身体一直比较虚弱。

sentences.en: The boy was absent from school yesterday because of illness.
sentences.zh: 因为生病，那个男孩昨天没去上学。

senses.zh: 疾病,某种具体疾病,不健康
